# Adithya Institute of Iyengar Yoga

> Iyengar yoga school in Vijayanagar, Bengaluru, taught by Narayan Sir, a direct student of B.K.S. Iyengar who has taught since 1989. A slow, precise practice with props, steady breath and no strain.

- Teacher: Narayan Sir. A direct student of B.K.S. Iyengar, teaching Iyengar yoga since 1989, and in Vijayanagar, Bengaluru since 2002. He speaks Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, English and Hindi.
- Classes: Monday to Friday, 06:00–10:00 and 16:00–20:00 (India time).
- Before the first class, call or email to confirm the batch, the fees and what to bring.
- Address: #37/4/24, Prashanth Nagar, I Main Road (Thimmenahalli), Vijayanagar, Bengaluru 560040, Karnataka, India. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/G2W5rmQw3kvCNjBH7
- Phone: +91 98456 15277. Email: adityaiyoga@gmail.com
- Also known as: Aditya Institute of Iyengar Yoga, Adithya Iyengar Yoga.

## Pages

- [Iyengar Yoga in Vijayanagar, Bengaluru · Adithya Institute](https://adithyaiyengaryoga.sreeb.dev/): Iyengar yoga in Vijayanagar, Bengaluru, taught by Narayan Sir, a direct student of B.K.S. Iyengar who has taught since 1989. A slow, supported practice for stiffness, pain and stress.
- [Yoga glossary: Sanskrit terms explained · Adithya Institute](https://adithyaiyengaryoga.sreeb.dev/glossary/): Sanskrit terms used in Iyengar yoga, from asana and pranayama to the eight limbs and the five koshas, each with a short meaning.
- [Narayan Sir, a direct student of B.K.S. Iyengar · Adithya Institute](https://adithyaiyengaryoga.sreeb.dev/narayan-sir/): The story of Narayan Sir, a direct student of B.K.S. Iyengar who has taught Iyengar yoga since 1989, and in Vijayanagar, Bengaluru since 2002.
- [What is Iyengar yoga? The practice · Adithya Institute](https://adithyaiyengaryoga.sreeb.dev/practice/): What Iyengar yoga is and how Narayan Sir teaches it: breath, attention, alignment, props and time, with answers to the questions beginners ask.
- [Roots: Patanjali and B.K.S. Iyengar · Adithya Institute](https://adithyaiyengaryoga.sreeb.dev/roots/): Where the practice comes from: Sage Patanjali and the Yoga Sutras, and B.K.S. Iyengar, Guruji, whose students include Narayan Sir.
- [Class times and address · Adithya Institute, Vijayanagar](https://adithyaiyengaryoga.sreeb.dev/visit/): Iyengar yoga classes Monday to Friday, 6–10 am and 4–8 pm, at Prashanth Nagar, Vijayanagar, Bengaluru 560040. Call +91 98456 15277 before your first visit.
- [Ways to practise · Adithya Institute of Iyengar Yoga](https://adithyaiyengaryoga.sreeb.dev/ways-to-practise/): How people practise at the Adithya Institute of Iyengar Yoga: general practice, therapeutic practice, pranayama, weight management, women's health and pregnancy.
